annotation.authors_or_issuer: Press Information Bureau, Government of India (Ministry of Civil Aviation)
key_provisions_or_claims: Drone Rules 2021 abolish many approvals, cut forms from 25 to 5 and fees from 72 to 4, based on trust and self-certification.
Airspace divided into red, yellow and green zones; no permission needed in green zones up to 500 kg.
Mandatory registration on Digital Sky platform, type certificates, and remote pilot licences with DGCA oversight.
PLI scheme offers 20% incentive on value addition, Rs 120 crore over three years.
Safety features like NPNT, geo-fencing and tracking to be notified later; penalties capped at INR one lakh.
annotation.summary_en: PIB backgrounder summarising India's liberalised Drone Rules 2021: drone classification by weight, airspace zones, registration, type certification, pilot licensing, import regulation, and the PLI incentive scheme. It frames government as enabler, stressing self-certification and growth toward India becoming a global drone hub by 2030.
